corrected_prior_findings: Adopted signal-error expiration no longer accepts ECHILD after the error and before the deadline.
Preflight failure and already-incomplete cleanup branches now retain publication finalization.
Duplicate publication-finish deadline records are rejected.
Boolean schema_version values are rejected by exact integer typing.
findings: The two initial post-fork observe_identity calls are outside the protected failure path. A first observation exception bypasses cleanup, pipe retirement and publication; a second observation exception also discards the first retained observation.
The oracle accepts duplicate direct wait-timeout records. It must require exactly one direct timeout when applicable while preserving separately joined TERM and KILL stage timeouts.
